title.en: MALACANANG TRANSFERRING THE PHILIPPINE CROP INSURANCE CORPORATION FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE TO THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE

text.en:
The Philippine Crop Insurance Corporation is hereby
transferred from the Department of Finance and attached to the Department
of Agriculture for policy and program coordination and for general
supervision.

All executive orders, rules and regulations and other
issuances inconsistent with the provisions of this Executive Order are hereby
revoked or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
City of Manila, February 28, 2002.
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
